description: 0/0 at x=0 combining a continuous exponential factor with the standard sinc-squared limit (sin x / x)^2 -> 1.

exercises.technique: 0/0 at x=0. Split as (e^{-x}+e^x) · (sin x / x)^2 / 2. The exponential factor is continuous (→2 at x=0) and the sinc-squared factor uses the standard limit sin x/x → 1.
